comparison.objective: Thread four food pieces onto a skewer held level, then return the assembly to the grill; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual skewer stabilization, hole-to-point alignment, sequential insertion, sliding, and regrasping versus recessed key seating, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: All four pieces must be threaded, the skewer kept level and laid back across the grill; candidate requires two measured safe stops and low post-lock drift. Level, insertion-depth, and damage thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Although both involve alignment and bimanual stabilization, sequential through-hole insertion is a meaningfully different tested ability.
